title: K-flatness of Hom from a bounded finite-projective ring complex
statement: Let A be a commutative ring and regard A-modules as sheaves on the bottom-topology one-object ringed site [def-pc-perfect-rhom-base-change-map]. Let P,Q be cochain complexes of these sheaves. Suppose there are integers a,b such that P^n is zero for n<a or b<n, each module P^n at the unique object is finite projective over A, and Q is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Then the shared Hom complex Hom_A^\bullet(P,Q) [def-pur-hom-complex] is K-flat.

source.place: Lemma 0A6A, lemma-base-change-RHom, clause (1); bounded finite-projective representative argument

proof.text: Use the actual dual D=Hom(P,A[0]) of lem-pc-perfect-ring-dual-term-flat. Prove directly in Lean that D is bounded above by -a: for n>-a each product factor Hom(P^p,A[0]^(p+n)) is zero. If p<a its source is zero; otherwise p+n>0 so its target is zero. The Hom product cone universal property then makes the identity of D^n zero. The two zero-factor claims are proved by extensionality of internal Hom maps.

Apply perfectRingDual_term_isFlat to hp and hf and the proved upper bound to CochainComplex.isKFlat_of_boundedAbove_flat on the ringed site. This gives D.IsKFlat directly, avoiding transport through module complexes.

For an arbitrary acyclic F, D.IsKFlat makes Tot(F tensor D) acyclic. Q.IsKFlat then makes Tot(Tot(F tensor D) tensor Q) acyclic. Tensor closedness supplies the coproduct-preservation instances needed by the Mathlib HomologicalComplex.associator, whose chain isomorphism transports this to Tot(F tensor Tot(D tensor Q)). Map perfectRingHom_tensorDual_iso through the bifunctor with F fixed and then total.mapIso; transporting exactness once more yields Tot(F tensor Hom(P,Q)) acyclic. This is the IsKFlat predicate.

proof_origin.note: Compiling reduction: dual boundedness proved via the shared Hom product; two finite-projective facts split off; site K-flatness and Mathlib associator used directly.

lean.statement: theorem perfectRingHom_isKFlat {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (P Q : CochainComplex (RingSiteModules A) ℤ) (hb : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (P.X n)) (hp : ∀ n : ℤ, Module.Projective A ((P.X n).val.obj (op ⟨PUnit.unit⟩))) (hf : ∀ n : ℤ, Module.Finite A ((P.X n).val.obj (op ⟨PUnit.unit⟩))) (hQ : Q.IsKFlat) : (homComplex (R := CochainComplex.onePointRingSheaf A) P Q).IsKFlat
